parties: Jaimin Kailash Gupta (acquirer); Varvee Global Limited (target)
headline: Jaimin Kailash Gupta files SEBI Takeover Disclosure for Varvee Global Limited
sum: Jaimin Kailash Gupta has filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure under SEBI's Takeover Regulations with NSE regarding substantial acquisition of shares in Varvee Global Limited, signalling a formal takeover announcement.
implication: The filing of Regulation 31(4) disclosure marks the transition from creeping acquisition to public mandatory offer, triggering the acquirer's obligation to make a full tender offer within 60 days under the SEBI Takeover Code.
detail: The disclosure was submitted to NSE as required under the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. Regulation 31(4) requires detailed disclosure when a person acquires shares triggering the 25% threshold. The filing initiates the formal takeover process with timelines and conditions set by SEBI.

framework.note: Central — mandates public disclosure of substantial acquisition; triggers mandatory offer requirement.

Establishes the 25% threshold triggering offer obligation.
Defines relevant corporate structure and shareholding framework.
Requires timely disclosure to stock exchange; conditions for trading suspension during offer.
Addresses creeping acquisition limits and exemptions.
Specifies content and format of takeover disclosure documents.

conditions: Filing of Regulation 31(4) disclosure with NSE
Mandatory offer to be made within 60 days of disclosure
Acceptance of offer subject to regulatory approval and other conditions precedent
approvals: SEBI clearance/no-objection for mandatory offer structure

triggers.note: Triggers when acquirer shareholding reaches/exceeds 25% threshold; requires immediate disclosure and mandatory offer initiation.
Once threshold triggered, acquirer must make open offer at fair price determined per SEBI valuation norms within statutory timeline.
